scripts.lect-effect/backend/clean:build:test: pnpm run _clean && pnpm run _build && pnpm run _test
scripts.lect-effect/build: pnpm run lect-effect/domain/build && pnpm run lect-effect/backend/build && pnpm run lect-effect/frontend/build
scripts.lect-effect/clean: pnpm run lect-effect/domain/clean && pnpm run lect-effect/backend/clean && pnpm run lect-effect/frontend/clean && pnpm run lect-effect/docs/clean
scripts.lect-effect/clean:build: pnpm run lect-effect/clean && pnpm run lect-effect/build
scripts.lect-effect/clean:build:test: pnpm run lect-effect/clean:build && pnpm run lect-effect/test
scripts.lect-effect/docs:generate: pnpm run lect-effect/backend/docs:generate && pnpm run lect-effect/domain/docs:generate && pnpm run lect-effect/frontend/docs:generate
scripts.lect-effect/install: pnpm run lect-effect/domain/install && pnpm run lect-effect/backend/install && pnpm run lect-effect/frontend/install && pnpm run lect-effect/docs/install
scripts.lect-effect/install:nofreeze: pnpm run lect-effect/domain/install:nofreeze && pnpm run lect-effect/backend/install:nofreeze && pnpm run lect-effect/frontend/install:nofreeze && pnpm run lect-effect/docs/install:nofreeze
scripts.lect-effect/run: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "pnpm run lect-effect/backend/start" "pnpm -C apps/frontend run lect-effect/frontend/start"
scripts.lect-effect/run:with-docs: concurrently --names backend,frontend,docs --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "pnpm run lect-effect/backend/start" "pnpm -C apps/frontend run lect-effect/frontend/start" "pnpm -C docs run lect-effect/docs/dev"
scripts.lect-effect/test: pnpm run lect-effect/domain/test && pnpm run lect-effect/backend/test && pnpm run lect-effect/frontend/test
scripts.build: pnpm run lect-effect/domain/build && pnpm run lect-effect/backend/build
scripts.migrate:masterdata:up: env-cmd -f .env --no-override node-pg-migrate --migration-filename-format utc -d MASTERDATA_PG_URL -m migrations/masterdatadb up
scripts.migrate:test-masterdata:up: env-cmd -f .env.test --no-override node-pg-migrate --migration-filename-format utc -d TEST_MASTERDATA_PG_URL -m migrations/masterdatadb up
scripts.test: pnpm run buildtest && env-cmd -f .env.test --no-override vitest run --no-file-parallelism
